verdict.rationale: LobeHub/LobeChat documents built-in agents that take delegated work. The composer can create a Task, agents can be scheduled to run tasks, and the Home dashboard shows what is still running and what agents did while you were away. A coordinating agent also hires, schedules and reports on your AI team. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that task delegation works as claimed, and in-depth first-party docs on the task lifecycle beyond changelog and marketing snippets.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The composer switches between Chat, Task, and Note, so the same box can open a Topic, create a Task, or start a page.
See what your Agents did while you were away.
Schedule tasks and let Agents handle the rest.
It hires, schedules, reports on your entire AI team. You stay in charge — without staying online.
Auto team formation: The system assembles the right Agents for the task.
